notes.title: Falling Into Dreams is Going From Paid to Free
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965883/8f3012efc5760e555a7011777b080a60c53c0601.png
Falling Into Dreams is transitioning from paid to free in the coming weeks. I'm making this change to reach a wider audience.

Thank you to everyone who purchased my game! I'm truly grateful.

- KarlFellOffTheCliff, Developer of Falling Into Dreams
